metadata.title: Soft Glow Portrait with Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, warm-toned close-up portrait of a woman with short blonde hair resting her chin on her hands, wearing a white textured garment, featuring minimalist, widely spaced sans-serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones harmonizing with a beige, grainy background
High-contrast dark eyes and lips against soft-focus skin
Textured white fabric framing the lower third of the face
Extreme horizontal letter spacing creating a sense of air and elegance
coreInvariants: Wide tracking in the display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up headshot centered vertically; the subject occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark, expressive eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead down to the hands resting under the chin, then to the widely spaced text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper right and lower corners, filled with a warm, grainy texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and cream tones (background and skin)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy or dark brown (typography and eye makeup)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high brightness; values are compressed in the highlights for a glowing effect.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on the lower portion of the subject's garment

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with extreme tracking to create visual interest.

candidateDirections.reason: Modern, clean, and authoritative when tracked out.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman with blonde hair, warm skin tones, resting her chin on her hands, wearing a white fuzzy sweater, against a warm beige grainy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in uppercase geometric sans-serif, centered at the bottom, using deep burgundy color and extreme horizontal tracking (spacing).

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the subject?
Is the color palette warm and golden?
Is the text color a dark contrast to the white sweater?
Is the skin texture soft and glowing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the white sweater has a visible 'fuzzy' or 'terry cloth' texture.
Verify that the eyes are the sharpest point in an otherwise soft image.
Confirm the background grain is subtle and not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key warm portrait with a single line of extremely tracked geometric sans-serif text in a dark earthy tone.
